case_name: Multi-level parking lift auto/manual positioning controller
expanded_nl: The controller belongs to a fully automatic level car-parking lift system used to take cars in and out and park them [E1], and the described installation has two lifts, three level-transfer mechanisms, one Beckhoff PLC, and VFD speed control for acceleration, deceleration, and stopping accuracy [E2][E3]. Dedicated sensing covers pallet position, lift-level positioning, safety interlocks, fork sensing for speed reduction, and slat-position confirmation for checking correct position [E4][E5][E6]. The operational sequence is divided into manual and auto modes: manual mode is inching for maintenance through spring-action up/down commands from the HMI or teach pendant at slow speed [E7][E8][E9]. Auto mode starts from a waiting-for-command phase; the command states direction and number of levels, and the lift then moves in the commanded direction [E10][E11]. The movement decision uses the signed difference destination level minus source level: the formula is shown as destination level no minus source level no, a negative result selects upward travel and initializes the level counter to one, while a positive example gives a down command with two levels to move [E12][E13][E14]. During automatic travel, fork-sensor input reduces VFD speed, and the stop fork sensor stops the lift [E15]. After stopping, level-position and level-confirmation sensors are checked; if a level difference remains, the confirmation sensor is absent and an error is given [E16][E17]. Across both upward and downward movements, Height/AntiLift sensors cut and stop operation when pallet engagement is improper, while over-travel sensors alarm when the lift goes above safe position limits [E18][E19]. The PLC-to-VFD interface exposes Forward, Backward, slow-speed, high-speed, and reset commands, and the PLC receives Run and Fault status feedback from the VFD [E20][E21].

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 A | paper.pdf p.1 Abstract | paper_content.txt 行 15-17
provenance.quote: In this paper a novel approach for lift control is proposed in fully automatic Level Car Parking System which used to take cars in/out of system & park the cars.
provenance.supports: fully automatic level car-parking lift system used to take cars in and out and park them

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 A | paper.pdf p.1 §1 INTRODUCTION | paper_content.txt 行 58-62
provenance.quote: The total system is having two lifts, three level transfer mechanisms. A single PLC (BECKHOFF PLC) is used to control the entire parking system.
provenance.supports: two lifts, three level-transfer mechanisms, one Beckhoff PLC

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 A | paper.pdf p.1 §1 INTRODUCTION | paper_content.txt 行 62-64
provenance.quote: For accurate speed control lift is operated with VFD. Speed control is required for acceleration/deceleration & proper stopping accuracy.
provenance.supports: VFD speed control for acceleration, deceleration, and stopping accuracy

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 A | paper.pdf p.1 Abstract | paper_content.txt 行 17-20
provenance.quote: The pallet position on lift, accurate positioning between lift-level & safety interlocks are sensed from dedicated sensor.
provenance.supports: dedicated sensing covers pallet position, lift-level positioning, and safety interlocks

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.1 §2 OVERVIEW DIAGRAM OF LIFT | paper_content.txt 行 82-84
provenance.quote: Fork sensor. This sensor is fixed and the dogs are mounted at each slat location. When input from this sensor is received the lift speed will be reduced.
provenance.supports: fork sensing for speed reduction

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.1 §2 OVERVIEW DIAGRAM OF LIFT | paper_content.txt 行 85-88
provenance.quote: Slat Position confirmation sensor: This is a retro-reflective sensor. This sensor are be used to confirm that the lift has reached the correct position.
provenance.supports: slat-position confirmation for checking correct position

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 145-147
provenance.quote: There are two types of sequences manual mode sequence and auto mode sequence.
provenance.supports: operational sequence is divided into manual and auto modes

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 149-151
provenance.quote: The lift manual mode operation is inching. The lift inched with spring action button in up or down direction for maintenance work.
provenance.supports: manual mode is inching for maintenance through spring-action up/down commands

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 151-154
provenance.quote: The speed in the manual/maintenance mode is slow speed. All manual mode actions are done from the HMI or from teach pendant.
provenance.supports: HMI or teach pendant commands at slow speed

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 159-161
provenance.quote: lift is always waiting for command in auto mode. The command given to the lift is in terms of direction and number of levels to move.
provenance.supports: auto mode starts waiting for a command containing direction and number of levels

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 161-163
provenance.quote: depending upon the command direction lift starts to move respective direction
provenance.supports: the lift moves in the commanded direction

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 171-178
provenance.quote: Number of levels to move = destination level no – source level no = 1 – 2 = -1. I.e. Counter value=1.
provenance.supports: destination level minus source level and signed negative example

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 178-180
provenance.quote: Since the number of levels to move < 0 so the direction is be up and the level counter is initialized to 1.
provenance.supports: negative result selects upward travel and initializes the level counter to one

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 185-189
provenance.quote: Here no of levels is positive, it means that lift has given down command & two levels to move.
provenance.supports: positive example gives a down command with two levels to move

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 163-165
provenance.quote: Once slow sensor(fork sensor) is sensed the speed of the VFD is made slow. As soon as the stop sensor(fork sensor) is sensed the lift stops.
provenance.supports: fork-sensor input reduces VFD speed and stop fork sensor stops the lift

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 165-167
provenance.quote: The level position sensors are checked to ensure that the lift is stopped correctly.
provenance.supports: after stopping, level-position sensors are checked

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 C | paper.pdf p.3 §4 OPERATIONAL SEQUENCE | paper_content.txt 行 167-169
provenance.quote: If there is a level difference, then the level confirmation sensor will not be sensed and error will be given.
provenance.supports: missing level confirmation when a level difference remains and an error is given

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.2 §2 OVERVIEW DIAGRAM OF LIFT | paper_content.txt 行 100-102
provenance.quote: If the lift pallet not engaged properly during up/down movements, then Height/AntiLift sensors cut and stop the operation of Lift.
provenance.supports: Height/AntiLift cut and stop operation during up/down movement when pallet engagement is improper

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.2 §2 OVERVIEW DIAGRAM OF LIFT | paper_content.txt 行 102-104
provenance.quote: The over travel sensors used to alarm the system that lift is going above the safe position limits.
provenance.supports: over-travel sensors alarm when the lift goes above safe position limits

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.2 §3 ELECTRICAL WIRING DIAGRAM OF VFD | paper_content.txt 行 118-120
provenance.quote: The control signals received from the PLC to VFD are Commands as Forward, Backward, slow speed, high speed, & reset.
provenance.supports: PLC-to-VFD Forward, Backward, slow-speed, high-speed, and reset commands

provenance.source: STM §1 摘录 B | paper.pdf p.2 §3 ELECTRICAL WIRING DIAGRAM OF VFD | paper_content.txt 行 120-121
provenance.quote: PLC receives feedback from VFD in terms of Run & Fault status signals.
provenance.supports: Run and Fault status feedback from the VFD

axis_coverage.C1: [E7]-[E10] 暴露了手动/自动 mode 边界，并把 auto mode 的进入起点写成 waiting-for-command phase；原文没有更深层层次结构，未编造子状态树。
axis_coverage.C2: [E11]-[E14] 暴露了 destination level、source level、signed difference、level counter 这些数值变量与 difference < 0 上行、positive 下行的自然语言 guard。
axis_coverage.C3: [E18][E19] 暴露了 up/down movement 范围内的横切安全语义：Height/AntiLift 可切断并停止运行，over-travel 可报警；原文不支持更强的 any-state emergency forced transition。
axis_coverage.C4: [E5][E15][E20][E21] 暴露了 fork sensor、stop fork sensor、VFD Forward/Backward/slow/high/reset 命令和 Run/Fault feedback 等物理 I/O 与 effector。

intentional_omissions: 没有加入阀门编号、压力/温度阈值、传感器型号、任意状态急停、自动恢复路径或 sin/log/exp 等数学函数，因为原文没有支持。也没有列出完整 flowchart state name 或长 I/O 表，只保留 mode、level difference、fork/confirmation/safety sensors 与 VFD 命令。
